steps.content: [Background - Dining Car]
Gossip spreads faster than any announcement. Word of the murder races through the car, and the dining car has descended into chaos.

The petite train attendant Allison finds herself trapped in the middle of the crowd. She stands on her toes, raises her voice, struggling to make herself heard over the storm of speculation and shouting.

steps.speaker: Attendant Allison
steps.content: Everyone, please calm down and listen! The situation is being handled—yes, we will ensure your complete safety, but the train cannot make an emergency stop. We must wait until we reach the destination before the police can assist us—
[Background - Train Corridor]
Behind a thin wall, the train conductor dabs the sweat on his temple with a handkerchief, mumbling instructions to a subordinate at his side.

steps.speaker: Train Conductor
steps.content: We can't keep this under the rug for long. It's not just first class—the passengers in the other cars will soon realize something's wrong...
He quickly glances out the window at the receding tracks.

steps.speaker: Train Conductor
steps.content: The train can't stop. I'm not sure if the killer is still on board, but we need to find them quickly... otherwise, when we reach the station, we're all finished!
The conductor lowers his voice, trying to keep the conversation hidden beneath the clamor from the dining car. However, his whispers come out strained and trembly.
A murder is the worst kind of scandal for a railway company. He never imagined he'd have to deal with something like this. Handling a murder investigation? That's well above his pay grade!

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: In that case, please allow me to assist.
You speak up before the man's sweat completely soaks through his handkerchief.

steps.speaker: Train Conductor
steps.content: You're... the other guest from Room 104?
The man's gaze sharpens instantly. His eyes narrow into slits as he sizes you up, his scrutiny making you uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Yesterday, the victim—Ms. Clementine—hired me to find a suspected killer on this train. And now, one night later, she's been murdered in the room next to mine...
You raise your wrist to check your watch. 11:15 AM. The train remains on course, ever so steady. There are less than nine hours until you arrive at the destination.
It's not much time, but enough nevertheless. If you work fast, that is. Fortunately, the scene remains untouched, and the passengers haven't scattered yet. As for the killer...

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: The killer is likely still on the train, hiding among the passengers.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: I understand that being in the room next to the victim makes me the prime suspect. But I must ask you to give me a chance to clear my name.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: I give you my word as Detective ${PlayerName}—I will uncover the truth behind this case.
You present your credentials. The man seems to recognize your name, and his expression suggests that he now feels conflicted. You press your advantage with one final offer—

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: If you still have doubts, you're welcome to assign someone to monitor my investigation and see if I make any suspicious moves.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: And, if the case remains unsolved by the time we reach our destination, you can hand me over to the authorities as your prime suspect.

Logic and emotion—a balanced appeal. It's at times like these when the persuasion skills you've honed from years of finding clients show their worth. The conductor's expression shifts repeatedly as he weighs your words, before finally relenting with a nod.
Now, the stage is yours, detective.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Seal off the crime scene and every compartment in this carriage. Don't let anyone clean or touch anything—every trace could be a vital clue.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Also, compile a list of everyone who entered or left the first-class carriage last night. I'll be interviewing them one by one shortly.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: One more thing... There's a passenger in second class with a medical background. Please bring her here. I'll need her assistance with examining the body. The attendant, Allison, will know who I'm referring to.
Examine the scene, document the evidence, interview the witnesses, then piece together the truth—
What exactly happened in Clementine's room last night?
